successCriteria.description: PgLeavePolicyRepository implements all 6 ILeavePolicyRepository methods (findById, findByLeaveType, findAll, create, update, delete) with correct signatures matching the interface exactly
All SQL queries use parameterized placeholders ($1, $2, ...) — no string interpolation or template-literal concatenation of user-supplied values into SQL
The barrel file (index.ts) exports exactly three symbols: LeavePolicy, ILeavePolicyRepository, PgLeavePolicyRepository — no internal symbols leak
create() generates a UUID via crypto.randomUUID(), sets createdAt and updatedAt to the same timestamp, and returns the persisted row with all fields populated

update() uses read-then-write: fetches the existing row, merges partial input (nullish coalescing for booleans, explicit undefined checks for nullable numbers), updates updatedAt, and returns the updated row or null if not found
delete() returns a boolean: true when rowCount > 0 (row existed and was deleted), false otherwise
findAll() returns results ordered by created_at DESC (most recent first)

constraints: Database access MUST go through the shared pool imported from src/shared/db/connection.ts — no inline pg.Pool instantiation, no direct pg imports outside the repository

Column names in SQL MUST use snake_case (policy_name, leave_type, entitlement_days, accrual_rate, max_accumulation, minimum_notice_days, requires_manager_approval, is_active, created_at, updated_at) to match the existing database schema

entityInvariants.invariant: Every LeavePolicy row MUST have a non-null id (UUID), policyName, leaveType, entitlementDays, requiresManagerApproval, isActive, createdAt, and updatedAt. accrualRate, maxAccumulation, and minimumNoticeDays are nullable. The leaveType value MUST be one of the LeaveType enum members defined in src/shared/types/index.ts.
